resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Italian source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Italian pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, grammar, and technical-clarity defects across electrical, circuit, trigonometric, thermal, heat-flux, and wire-gauge content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Italian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Joule worked formula used L instead of W for power.
evidence: The previous expression ended with 7,2 L.
findings.resolution: Restored P = I^2 × R = 3^2 × 0,8 = 7,2 W.

findings.summary: The Joule example described power as joules per second without stating watts clearly.
evidence: The previous conclusion used 7,2 joule al secondo.
findings.resolution: Clarified the result as 7,2 W or 72 J in 10 seconds.

findings.summary: The heat-transfer bullet retained the English loanword hardware.
evidence: The previous bullet ended with all'hardware.
findings.resolution: Changed it to alle apparecchiature.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff current-law title was mistranslated as the current or present law.
evidence: The previous title was L'attuale legge di Kirchhoff.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Legge della corrente di Kirchhoff.

findings.summary: The current-law paragraph used direzioni attuali instead of directions of current.
evidence: The previous sentence instructed the reader to choose direzioni attuali.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with direzioni delle correnti and natural Italian agreement.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff voltage-law formula omitted spacing around the sigma term.
evidence: The previous expression was ΣV = 0.
findings.resolution: Restored Σ V = 0.

findings.summary: The parallel-branch voltage formula localized the protected total-voltage variable.
evidence: The previous expression used V_totale.
findings.resolution: Restored V_total = V_1 = V_2 = ... with the Italian branch note.

findings.summary: The series-cell bullet used an awkward phrase for ampere-hour capacity.
evidence: The previous bullet used capacità amperora without the natural unit phrase.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as capacità in ampere-ora.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell bullet used an incomplete formulation for approximately additive current and capacity.
evidence: The previous bullet used si aggiungono approssimativamente without a clear subject pair.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with natural Italian wording for capacity and available current.

findings.summary: The sine formula localized protected triangle-side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used opposto and ipotenusa inside the formula.
findings.resolution: Restored sin(θ) = opposite / hypotenuse.

findings.summary: The cosine formula localized protected triangle-side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used adiacente and ipotenusa inside the formula.
findings.resolution: Restored cos(θ) = adjacent / hypotenuse.

findings.summary: The tangent formula localized protected triangle-side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used opposto and adiacente inside the formula.
findings.resolution: Restored tan(θ) = opposite / adjacent.

findings.summary: The inverse-sine formula localized protected triangle-side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used opposto and ipotenusa inside the formula.
findings.resolution: Restored θ = sin^-1(opposite / hypotenuse).

findings.summary: The inverse-cosine formula localized protected triangle-side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used adiacente and ipotenusa inside the formula.
findings.resolution: Restored θ = cos^-1(adjacent / hypotenuse).

findings.summary: The inverse-tangent formula localized protected triangle-side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used opposto and adiacente inside the formula.
findings.resolution: Restored θ = tan^-1(opposite / adjacent).

findings.summary: The degree-to-radian formula localized the protected degree variable.
evidence: The previous expression used θ_gradi.
findings.resolution: Restored θ_rad = θ_deg × π / 180.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating conclusion spelled out the validated seconds result.
evidence: The previous conclusion ended with 523 secondi rather than protected 523 s notation.
findings.resolution: Changed it to approximately 523 s.

findings.summary: The phase-change limitations referred to specific heat rather than specific heat capacity.
evidence: The previous paragraph used calore specifico in the simplifying assumption.
findings.resolution: Changed it to capacità termica specifica and clarified nonuniform temperature.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name did not identify the per-area density quantity.
evidence: The previous display name was Flusso di calore.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Densità di flusso termico.

findings.summary: The heat-flux description used the general heat-flow term instead of heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous description repeatedly used flusso di calore without the per-area qualifier.
findings.resolution: Aligned it with densità di flusso termico.

findings.summary: The heat-flux summary did not use the standard per-unit-area phrasing.
evidence: The previous summary described transfer through an area unit indirectly.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the rate of heat transfer per unit surface.

findings.summary: The q'' definition called the quantity heat flow rather than heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous bullet said q'' è il flusso di calore.
findings.resolution: Defined q'' as densità di flusso termico in W/m².

findings.summary: The heat-flux example conclusion used the general heat-flow term after the quantity was defined as density.
evidence: The previous conclusion said flusso di calore medio.
findings.resolution: Aligned it with densità media di flusso termico.

findings.summary: The convection paragraph used coefficiente superficiale rather than the convection coefficient.
evidence: The previous paragraph referred to a generic surface coefficient h.
findings.resolution: Changed it to coefficiente di convezione h and retained Kelvin.

findings.summary: The stranded-conductor instruction used an awkward singular construction and inconsistent imperative mood.
evidence: The previous bullet used costruzione del trefolo and an infinitive among informal instructions.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with costruzione dei trefoli and a consistent informal imperative.
